newsitem.title: USA: Driver skips drive-in window, heads through door.
newsitem.headline: Driver skips drive-in window, heads through door.

text.p: A van burst through the front entrance of a McDonald's restaurant in this Chicago suburb Monday, killing one woman sitting in the booth and showering glass on other patrons, police said.
The 48-year-old woman died from severe injuries and the driver, a 60-year-old man, was in serious condition after his van inexplicably went across a field and into the restaurant at high speed.
Employees said the impact sounded like a bomb and workers at the restaurant's drive-in window scrambled to escape as gasoline leaked from the van's gas tank.
Two other patrons were slightly hurt by flying glass.
